metaTitle: Fortune Cookie — A little luck for everyone
metaDescription: Crack a fortune cookie and receive a positive fortune in your language. Free, instant, in 30 languages.
headline: What good fortune awaits you today?
subline: Crack a cookie and receive a warm wish, just for you.
cookieAria: Fortune cookie. Press Enter or Space to crack it open.
footerNote: Made with good wishes for everyone.
aboutBody: Fortune Cookie is a small corner of the internet that wishes you well. Every cookie holds a positive message in your language. It is for fun and encouragement — no predictions, no accounts, no limits.
privacyBody: We collect no personal data and use no trackers. Your language choice and session count stay on your own device. Cracking cookies works entirely in your browser.
offlineNote: You are offline — your cached fortunes still work!
